verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only human-facing web filing: the Annual Report Wizard, online entity formation, a UCC/EFS/Buyer E-Filing System for 'Authorized Users', and Commercial Registered Agent registration. None of these is documented as a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter programs, or batch providers, and no enrollment path for one is published. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, no llms.txt, and no documented public API on the agency's hosts, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.
